basic_details.job_title: VVGNLI Research Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: V.V. Giri National Labour Institute (VVGNLI) is recruiting for the Research Associate post on a contractual basis for a tenure of 6 months, with a consolidated pay of Rs. 27,346 plus PF, ESI etc. Candidates applying for this post must possess a Master’s Degree in Social Science, preferably Economics, Sociology, Labour Studies, along with research experience, understanding of quantitative/qualitative data, proficiency in MS Excel and SPSS/STATA, and excellent written English - grammar. Eligible candidates can apply by email by submitting complete personal, academic, and professional details alo

qualification.details: Master’s Degree in Social Science, preferably Economics, Sociology, Labour Studies. Research experience and understanding of quantitative/qualitative data. Proficiency in MS Excel and SPSS/STATA is essential. Excellent written English - Grammar, Academic Writing.

selection_process: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their complete personal
and professional details along with the submitted sample write up.
how_to_apply: Prepare complete personal, academic, and professional details.
Prepare a sample write up as required for shortlisting.
Send the application via email to the contact email address provided by the institute.
Ensure the application is submitted on or before 23.10.2026.
important_instructions: Applicants must apply with complete personal, academic, and professional details. A sample write up must be included with the application to be considered for shortlisting. Applications must be sent to the designated contact email before the deadline.

content_sections.heading: VVGNLI Research Associate at a Glance
Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential educational qualifications and requirements specified by the institute to be considered for the Research Associate position. Master’s Degree in Social Science, preferably Economics, Sociology, Labour Studies. Research experience and understanding of quantitative/qualitative data. Proficiency in MS Excel and SPSS/STATA is essential. Excellent written English - Grammar, Academic Writing.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Research Associate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 27,346/- per month along with additional benefits such as PF, ESI etc. The engagement is purely on a contractual basis for a duration of 6 months.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for VVGNLI Research Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare complete personal, academic, and professional details. Prepare a sample write up as required for shortlisting. Send the application via email to the contact email address provided by the institute. Ensure the application is submitted on or before 23.10.2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on their complete personal, academic, and professional details along with the submitted sample write up.
